lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible in the mid-flank region, forming anchor nodes where they intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is observed on the dorsal-lateral interface, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the superior margin and lower-intensity shadow on the inferior margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible dorsal fin displays a scattered distribution of high-luminance blobs; the trailing edge and base show a higher density of spots compared to the leading edge region.
